name: How can I prepare my home for a remodeling project?
description: Prepare by clearing the work area, protecting adjacent spaces, and discussing utility access and site routines with your contractor.

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before remodeling begins, you should declutter and clear the project area of furniture, personal items, and valuables. Protect adjacent areas with drop cloths or plastic sheeting, and consider where essential services like electricity or water might be temporarily rerouted. Discuss with your contractor about utility shut-offs, access routes for workers, and waste disposal. Establishing clear expectations for site cleanliness and daily routines also helps smooth the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, protecting adjacent spaces, and discussing utility access and site routines with your contractor.
